notes.trinkets: As Marksmanship, we want a powerful on-use Trinket to pair with our Trueshot , which is Voracious Heart of Ula'tek . In addition, we pick Font of Venomous Rage . Despite Font technically being an on-use, it does not especially benefit from being cast with Trueshot as it does damage on its own.
